beats.say: Three simple questions. What is a moat? Why does it matter? And what do we do about it?
cues: Three simple questions.
What is a moat?
Why does it matter?
And what do we do about it?

beats.say: Picture a castle. Around it is a moat: a ring of deep water. Attackers cannot simply walk up to the walls.
cues: Picture a castle.
Around it is a moat:
a ring of deep water.
Attackers cannot simply walk up to the walls.

beats.say: In business, a moat is the same idea. It is whatever stops competitors from taking a company's customers, and its profits.
cues: In business, a moat is the same idea.
It is whatever stops competitors from taking a company's
customers, and its profits.

beats.say: Here is an everyday example. Two tea shops on one street. Then a new shop opens next door, and sells tea two rupees cheaper. Shop A's customers walk over to the new shop. Shop B's customers stay.
cues: Here is an everyday example.
Two tea shops on one street.
Then a new shop opens next door,
and sells tea two rupees cheaper.
Shop A's customers walk over to the new shop.
Shop B's customers stay.

beats.say: Why does Shop B keep them? Maybe it buys milk cheaper than anyone, so it can match any price. Maybe its regulars would lose their loyalty card. Maybe it is the only shop open at five in the morning. Each of these is a moat.
cues: Why does Shop B keep them?
Maybe it buys milk cheaper than anyone,
so it can match any price.
Maybe its regulars would lose their loyalty card.
Maybe it is the only shop open at five in the morning.
Each of these is a moat.

beats.say: So why does a moat matter?
cues: So why does a moat matter?

beats.say: When a business earns good profits, rivals notice. They copy it. They cut prices. And the profits shrink. Without a moat, that is what usually happens.
cues: When a business earns good profits, rivals notice.
They copy it.
They cut prices.
And the profits shrink.
Without a moat, that is what usually happens.

beats.say: With a moat, a business can keep earning well for many years. And for a long-term investor, that is the question that matters most.
cues: With a moat, a business can keep earning well for many
years.
And for a long-term investor,
that is the question that matters most.

beats.say: Not how much a company earns this year. But how long it can keep earning.
cues: Not how much a company earns this year.
But how long it can keep earning.

beats.say: So what do we do? Moat and Margin looks for moats in Indian listed companies, in three steps.
cues: So what do we do?
Moat and Margin looks for moats in Indian listed companies,
in three steps.

beats.say: Step one: read. We read each company's own documents: its results, annual reports and stock exchange filings. Not rumours. Not tips.

beats.say: Step two: score. Our MoatSCORE checks seven kinds of moat. For example, customers who find it hard to switch, costs lower than rivals, or a product that gets better as more people use it. About five hundred Indian companies are scored so far.
